articles.title: Mark Cuban says he sold most of his Bitcoin after failed hedge narrative 'disappointed' the billionaire
articles.snippet: The billionaire investor said he sold most of his bitcoin after concluding the cryptocurrency failed to act as a hedge during recent geopolitical turmoil and dollar weakness.

articles.title: MoonPay expands into tokenized assets and DeFi markets with new platform for banks
articles.snippet: With MoonPay Trade, the crypto payments firm is building infrastructure for banks, fintechs to access stablecoins, tokenized funds and yield in a one-stop shop.

articles.title: Peer-to-peer trading startup Variational raises $50 million for real-world perps in funding round led by Dragonfly
articles.snippet: The company is initially offering perpetual futures on real-world assets including oil, silver, copper and gold.

articles.title: CoinDesk 20 performance update: Internet Computer drops 1.6%, leading index lower
articles.snippet: Hedera (HBAR), down 1.3% from Wednesday, joined Internet Computer (ICP) as an underperformer.

articles.title: The $6 billion expiration countdown: Traders pile into $82,000 bitcoin calls ahead of May 29 expiry
articles.snippet: Deribit’s bitcoin open interest has overtaken BlackRock’s IBIT as traders brace for a showdown between $75K max pain and $80K call positioning.
